Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2964; to invalidate:--disannul, make of none effect.
BiblicalUsage: The word is to invalidate, to make void. Jesus charges the Pharisees with making God's word of none effect by your tradition; Mark repeats it; and Paul says the law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul the covenant God made with Abraham. In every case something human tries to cancel something divine — and fails.
TheologicalSignificance: Tradition cannot void the Word, and the law cannot void the promise. I hold that this word is the Bible's own guarantee: what God has spoken stands, and no human addition or later rule can annul it.
RelatedTopics: Covenant; Promises of God; Word of God
